data.credibility: Management often guides positive operational targets but frequently revises, lowers, or drops specific metrics like revenue growth or engine deliveries. While major order books and margins show strength, long-term operational forecasts are routinely delayed.

lines.line: Promised 26% to 27% EBITDA margin; delivered 31% in Q4 FY23.
Promised 10% to 12% ROH growth; dropped after delays.
Promised Rs. 15,000 crore cash balance; dropped from reporting.
Promised 3 units for Mark1A LCA; delivered 3 units in Q4 FY23.
Promised 10% revenue growth from FY25; slipping with lowered targets.
Promised 14% to 15% revenue stabilization; slipping and not mentioned.
Promised INR 48,000 crore order value; dropped.
Promised manpower cost at 16% of revenue; dropped.
Promised 14,000 to 15,000 crores CAPEX over 5 years; on track.
Promised 1,20,000 crore order book by March 2025; delivered 1,89,300 crore.
Promised Nashik line operational in October FY25; delivered after delay.
Promised 27% operating profit to revenue; slipping with 24.9% actual.
Promised 12 LCA engines in CY25; missed.
Promised Tejas Mark-2 prototype in Q1 FY27; slipping.
Promised GE F414 deal in FY26; slipping.
Promised 30 LCA capacity per year; on track.
Promised INR 12,000 crores infrastructure investment by 2030; pending.
Promised INR 90,000 crores orders in next 2 years; pending.
Promised Tejas Mark II rollout by March; pending.

overrides.reason: Ledger indicates history shows lowered and not mentioned, confirming dropped status.
Actual operating profit is 24.9% against a promised 27% target.

bull: Net profit compounded at 23.0% over five years, with an EBITDA margin widening from 23.5% in FY21 to 29.6% in FY26.
The outstanding order book reached 1,89,300 crores by Q4 FY25, surpassing the initial guidance of 1,20,000 crores.
Operating cash flow is robust at 144% of reported profit over 5 years, supporting an almost debt-free balance sheet.
bear: Working-capital days have stretched significantly from 141 to 301 days over the past 5 years.
Management has repeatedly missed or slipped on key operational timelines, such as missing the 12 LCA engines target for CY25.
Export share remains minimal at 1.58% of total turnover in FY25-26, highlighting heavy reliance on domestic defense customers.
